name: restosignals
description: US restaurants and bars 1-6 months before they open. Fuses public liquor-license applications, food-service permits and new-business filings into one deduplicated venue, scored 0-100 for how close it is to opening, with the owner contact from those filings. Also looks up liquor licenses (type, status, expiration) from state records. Hosted remote server: sign in through your MCP client (OAuth 2.1), or send an API key from https://restosignals.com as an Authorization Bearer header. 100 free credits on sign-up, no card; the coverage tool needs no key.

RESTOSIGNALS_API_KEY.description: RestoSignals API key (starts with pk_) from https://restosignals.com. Only needed for clients that cannot sign in with OAuth. Never commit your key.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. OAuth-capable clients open a one-time sign-in; no API key is needed for this path.

http-api-key.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server using your RestoSignals API key instead of OAuth, for clients without a sign-in window.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: List the states RestoSignals currently has data for and how many scored venues each holds, with a count of hot leads (opening_score >= 80). Free and needs no API key; call it first.

tools.name: new_openings
tools.description: Find restaurants and bars about to open in a state, ranked by opening_score (0-100), fused from liquor licenses, food permits and new-business filings. Each lead has a contact block (owner name from the filing, plus phone or owner mailing address where public records carry them). 1 credit per returned lead.

tools.name: watch_area
tools.description: Register a webhook that fires when a new matching venue appears in an area. criteria = {state, city, signal_type, min_opening_score}. Paid accounts only.

tools.name: lookup_liquor_license
tools.description: Look up liquor licenses in TX, CA, NY, VA, FL, OR, CO or the City of Chicago by business name, owner name, premises address or license number. Returns license number, type, status and expiration date from the state's own records. 1 credit per returned license.

tools.name: venue_signals
tools.description: Return the raw liquor, permit and business filings that were fused into one venue, for transparency. 1 credit.
